A polynomial f∈R[T] is monic when its leading coefficient is the unit 1_R, precisely the same defining property of a monic polynomial over a field k. Passing from the field in the minimal-polynomial source to a commutative unital local ring in the Henselian source does not alter this general leading-coefficient condition. Simple-root lifting and the residue field remain different independent prerequisites.
